# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Blue Bolt Loop Rush` as a portrait-first browser canvas endless runner/platformer. Preserve the exact mechanic truth: a start overlay leads to active play; the player uses tap/click to jump, can perform one air jump, lands on horizontally scrolling platforms, gains one ring/point after each platform is passed, speeds up over distance, and loses by falling or hitting a platform face. Reinterpret the presentation as a Sonic-inspired but original neon arcade world: a rebellious blue quill speedster, loop-heavy rail silhouettes, gold ring score feedback, cyan/pink/lime booster decks, kinetic particles, readable HUD chips, large touch CTAs, and a clear restart flow. Use browser-native HTML/CSS/Canvas/JS with catalog-backed fonts and approved remote audio only.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser canvas endless runner/platformer. The player starts from an overlay, taps or clicks to jump, may jump a second time in air, lands on scrolling platforms, earns one point when a platform is passed, gradually speeds up, and loses by falling below the viewport or colliding with a platform face.

## Protected mechanics
- Start, play, game-over, restart state flow.
- Single primary tap/click input with one air jump.
- Gravity and vertical velocity platforming.
- Horizontally scrolling generated platforms.
- Landing collision from above only.
- Side/fall failure.
- Score increment once per passed platform.
- Distance-based speed increase.

## Safe transformation surfaces
Canvas drawing, player silhouette, platform art, background, HUD language, CTA copy, fonts, colors, particles, audio labels, feedback text, and mobile visual hierarchy are safe to transform.

## Remixed target
Blue Bolt Loop Rush reframes the same mechanics as a rebellious blue quill speedster racing through neon loop rails, building ring score by clearing rails and mastering momentum in portrait-first arcade play.
